LanguageServer.Description:
Description

This package provides a language server for Macaulay2 implementing the Language Server Protocol (LSP). It is used via the M2-language-server script, which is distributed with Macaulay2 and starts the server with standard input and output as the communication channel.

The language server is supported out of the box by the following editors:

  • the Macaulay2 major mode for Emacs, using eglot or lsp-mode
  • the Macaulay2 extension for VS Code
  • the Macaulay2 plugin for Neovim

LSPServer.Description:
Description

LSPServer is the main class of the package. It wraps a JSON-RPC server and handles the LSP lifecycle: initialize, text document synchronization, and shutdown.

setLogger(LSPServer,Function).Description:
Description

Sets a custom logging function for server. The function f should accept a single string. For example, to log to standard error:

i1 : server = new LSPServer

o1 = server

o1 : LSPServer
i2 : setLogger(server, printerr)

o2 = printerr

o2 : FunctionClosure

start.Description:
Description

Starts the language server, reading LSP messages from stdio and writing responses back to stdio. This is called automatically by the M2-language-server script and is not typically invoked directly by the user.
